verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the API reference's claim that "every endpoint in this reference has a generated command". That hints at a command-line interface mapped to the API, but it is never named as an official CLI and may only mean curl snippets like the one shown on the developers page. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official CLI, install and usage docs, AI-agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
